articles.title: Recurrent implantation failure: a committee opinion.
articles.excerpt: Patients who have several unsuccessful embryo transfers may be at risk for possible conditions that affect implantation. This document reviews diagnostic criteria for recurrent implantation failure and provides an evidence-based evaluation for these patients. · Fertility and sterility · Journal Article, Review · DOI: 10.1016/j.fertnstert.2026.03.026
articles.summary: 该委员会意见聚焦复发性种植失败（RIF），指出多次胚胎移植失败患者可能存在影响胚胎着床的相关疾病，并系统回顾了RIF的诊断标准，为这类患者提供基于证据的临床评估路径。内容属于生殖医学领域的专业指导，具有临床价值。

articles.title: Chinese expert consensus on the management of cervical intraepithelial neoplasia grade 2 (CIN 2) (2026 edition)
articles.source: GOCM · Gynecology and Obstetrics Clinical Medicine · Guidelines and Consensus
articles.summary: 该文为2026年版中国专家共识，针对宫颈上皮内瘤变2级（CIN 2）的管理策略进行规范与推荐，涵盖诊断、处理及随访等关键环节，对妇科肿瘤及宫颈病变临床实践具有指导意义。
